*Description*
Create a generic framework for running historical backfill jobs by data source and date range.

*Tasks*

* CLI or config-driven job runner
* Parameters: data source, start date, end date
* Chunking logic (e.g. daily/hourly)
* Progress tracking & logging

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Backfill can be run for arbitrary date ranges
* Jobs can resume after failure
* Logs clearly show progress and failures
